# Issue Library

<!-- Generated by `python -m agent_insights_quality generate-docs`; do not edit. -->

This file lists every predefined, reviewed scenario contract. Daily assignment is a
deterministic weekday subset governed by `config/selection-policy.yaml`; omission from one
day is reviewed cadence or rotation, not retirement or a change to ground truth.

Active contracts: **63** across **9** categories.

## context_memory

| Scenario | Priority | Daily cadence | Expected roots | Root-cause contract | Fix boundary |
| --- | --- | --- | ---: | --- | --- |
| `aiq-scn-008-system-prompt-drift` - System prompt instruction drift | P1 | Once per Monday-Friday cycle | 1 | The agent follows a conflicting instruction instead of the reviewed system contract. | Reinforce system instruction precedence without changing task behavior. |
| `aiq-scn-009-ignored-user-correction` - Ignored explicit user correction | P1 | Once per Monday-Friday cycle | 1 | The agent ignores the latest explicit user correction and continues with stale context. | Make explicit user corrections supersede earlier same-scope values. |
| `aiq-scn-031-stale-entity-context` - Stale entity substituted | P1 | Once per Monday-Friday cycle | 1 | The agent substitutes a stale entity from earlier context. | Bind each operation to the latest explicit entity in scope. |
| `aiq-scn-032-dropped-standing-constraint` - Dropped standing constraint | P1 | Once per Monday-Friday cycle | 1 | The agent drops a standing user constraint before completing the task. | Preserve active standing constraints across the bounded session. |
| `aiq-scn-033-cross-entity-contamination` - Cross-entity context contamination | P0 | Every weekday | 1 | The agent contaminates the current response with another synthetic entity's data. | Isolate context and tool results by current synthetic entity scope. |
| `aiq-scn-053-handoff-lost-constraints` - Constraints lost during handoff | P1 | Once per Monday-Friday cycle | 1 | The parent omits a required constraint from the child handoff. | Include all active task constraints in the bounded handoff payload. |

| Scenario | Priority | Daily cadence | Expected roots | Root-cause contract | Fix boundary |
| --- | --- | --- | ---: | --- | --- |
| `aiq-scn-034-context-explosion` - Unbounded context explosion | P1 | Once per Monday-Friday cycle | 1 | The agent repeatedly includes irrelevant full-dataset context. | Project only task-relevant bounded context into each model request. |
| `aiq-scn-035-history-duplication` - Repeated history and tool payload | P1 | Once per Monday-Friday cycle | 1 | The agent duplicates history and tool payloads in model context. | Include each required history item and tool payload once. |

| Scenario | Priority | Daily cadence | Expected roots | Root-cause contract | Fix boundary |
| --- | --- | --- | ---: | --- | --- |
| `aiq-scn-022-unbounded-identical-retry` - Unbounded identical retry | P1 | Once per Monday-Friday cycle | 1 | The agent repeats an identical failed operation beyond the reviewed retry bound. | Stop at the retry bound and surface the permanent failure. |
| `aiq-scn-023-bad-fallback` - Invalid recovery fallback | P1 | Once per Monday-Friday cycle | 1 | The agent chooses a fallback that cannot satisfy the requested task. | Use only reviewed fallbacks that preserve task and evidence requirements. |
| `aiq-scn-024-failed-escalation` - Failed required escalation | P1 | Once per Monday-Friday cycle | 1 | The agent fails to invoke the available escalation after recovery is exhausted. | Dispatch the reviewed escalation with bounded synthetic context. |
| `aiq-scn-028-task-evasion-no-op` - Task evasion or no-op response | P1 | Once per Monday-Friday cycle | 1 | The agent evades a supported task and performs no useful operation. | Execute the supported bounded task or state a concrete blocking condition. |
| `aiq-scn-048-pre-model-abort` - Pre-model orchestration abort | P1 | Once per Monday-Friday cycle | 1 | The orchestration layer aborts a valid request before model dispatch. | Handle valid request initialization before model dispatch. |
| `aiq-scn-049-post-tool-abort` - Post-tool orchestration abort | P1 | Once per Monday-Friday cycle | 1 | The orchestration layer aborts after the required tool succeeds. | Preserve successful tool state through final response synthesis. |
| `aiq-scn-050-model-failure` - Unhandled model failure | P1 | Once per Monday-Friday cycle | 1 | The agent fails to handle a deterministic model invocation error. | Apply the reviewed bounded model failure handling policy. |
| `aiq-scn-051-success-reported-no-op` - Success reported for no-op | P1 | Once per Monday-Friday cycle | 1 | The agent reports success even though the required operation was not performed. | Report success only after verified operation completion. |
| `aiq-scn-052-bad-agent-handoff` - Incorrect multi-agent handoff | P1 | Once per Monday-Friday cycle | 1 | The parent delegates the subtask to an incompatible child agent. | Select child agents only from declared compatible capabilities. |
| `aiq-scn-055-parent-child-correlation` - Parent-child trace correlation control | P0 | Every weekday | 1 | Agent Insights fails to correlate the child failure with its parent invocation. | Correlate nested spans using the read-only operation hierarchy. |
| `aiq-scn-058-cross-version-stale-finding` - Cross-version stale finding | P0 | Every weekday | 1 | Agent Insights attributes prior-version evidence to the corrected immutable version. | Scope evidence and finding identity to immutable version and half-open window. |
| `aiq-scn-059-cross-window-dedup` - Same root cause repeated across windows | P1 | Once per Monday-Friday cycle | 1 | Agent Insights emits a second active card for the same versioned root cause. | Deduplicate active findings by root cause and immutable version. |
| `aiq-scn-060-fixed-issue-recurrence` - Fixed issue recurrence | P0 | Every weekday | 1 | Agent Insights fails to identify recurrence after a corrected immutable version. | Reopen root-cause identity only after evidence from a later faulted version. |
| `aiq-scn-061-duplicate-insight-cards` - Duplicate cards for one root cause | P0 | Every weekday | 1 | Agent Insights creates duplicate cards for one independently fixable root cause. | Merge equivalent symptoms into one root-cause card. |
| `aiq-scn-062-umbrella-insight` - Umbrella card merges distinct root causes | P0 | Monday/Wednesday/Friday | 2 | Agent Insights collapses distinct independently fixable root causes into one umbrella card. | Emit one specific card per independently fixable root cause. |
| `aiq-scn-063-symptom-fragmentation` - Symptom and root-cause fragmentation | P1 | Once per Monday-Friday cycle | 1 | Agent Insights fragments one root cause into separate symptom-level cards. | Group symptoms by the single independently fixable root cause. |
